1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.d3 f5 4.exf5.strategy: Wins a pawn. Black's f-pawn has left the king's cover, and the half-open f-file and quick development are all Black has in return. White's solid d3 pawn keeps the position safe while the pieces come out.
1.e4 e5 2.Nf3 Nc6 3.d3 f5 4.exf5.name: Latvian Gambit: Clam Gambit
